verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of recurring workflows is a single fragmentary marketing line saying Vanta automates reminders and workflows to regularly assess risk. Continuous monitoring and automated tests are platform-run behavior, not user-scheduled jobs, so they get no credit. missing for 10: a documented user-configurable scheduler for recurring jobs/workflows (cadence, triggers, management), API or MCP-accessible scheduling for AI-native use, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
